explication: ebook2audiobook converts an ebook or direct text into chaptered audiobook files. A user starts either the CLI or Gradio UI, selects language, voice, engine, and output settings; the conversion core extracts and prepares text, optionally analyzes characters/SML and clones a voice, dispatches sentences through a registered TTS engine, then writes audio, chapters, and metadata. The repository also includes optional SML dialog extraction and fine-tuning tools. Some orchestration details are unsampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
